title: Intelligent Urban Traffic Choking Detection & Flow Optimization
summary: Real-time edge computer vision pipeline detecting road bottlenecks, choke points, and congestion density on urban Islamabad roadways with 91.4% mAP at 42 FPS.
role: Lead Computer Vision Researcher & Engineer (Final Year Project)
problem: Urban arterial roads in developing metropolitan areas face persistent unmonitored choke points caused by irregular lane discipline, sudden stops, and unregulated roadside friction. Standard loop detectors and fixed sensors cannot capture spatial congestion dynamics or distinguish moving vs stalled traffic clusters.
solution: Developed an end-to-end computer vision framework utilizing a customized YOLOv8 model trained on a locally curated dataset of Islamabad intersections. The pipeline computes localized density vectors, tracks vehicle velocity clusters, and detects road choking within 2.5 seconds of onset.
architecture: 1. Multi-Camera Stream Capture -> 2. Adaptive Frame Preprocessing & ROI Masking -> 3. Edge YOLOv8 Inference with TensorRT Quantization -> 4. Choke Density Clustering & Velocity Vector Analysis -> 5. Real-Time Telemetry Dispatch & Operator Dashboard.
results: Achieved 91.4% mAP@0.5 across 8 vehicle categories (cars, vans, rickshaws, motorcycles, heavy vehicles, pedestrians, bikes, buses). Optimized the network to run at 42 FPS with 23.8ms latency on edge hardware, enabling instant traffic bottleneck alarms.
challenges: Extremely varied lighting, occlusions by heavy foliage, and heterogeneous vehicle compositions (rickshaws and two-wheelers) caused standard pre-trained models to collapse. Solved by curating a diverse 4,200-frame Pakistani road dataset and implementing Mosaic augmentation with focal loss re-weighting.

title: Enterprise AI Smart Health Diagnostic & Triage Platform
summary: HIPAA-conscious multi-tenant medical diagnostic assistance platform featuring RBAC, secure API gateways, and automated symptom triaging.
problem: Clinical queues are frequently choked by inefficient preliminary paperwork and manual triage classification, leading to delayed medical attention for high-acuity patients and potential human oversight.
solution: Built a production-grade diagnostic assistance portal that collects standardized symptom streams, applies structured differential triage recommendations, and strictly separates clinician vs patient access via fine-grained RBAC.
architecture: Next.js Frontend Client -> HTTPS Gateway / Rate Limiter -> FastAPI Service with JWT RBAC Middleware -> PostgreSQL Database with AES-256 field encryption -> LLM Triage Reasoning Module with deterministic guardrails.
results: Cut clinical front-desk intake latency by 65%. Successfully passed 4 rounds of automated vulnerability audits (OWASP Top 10 compliance) with zero credential leaks or unauthorized privilege escalations.
challenges: Ensuring strict patient privacy while maintaining snappy LLM response times. Implemented local cryptographic anonymization before sending de-identified clinical tokens to the inference engine.

title: ArticleSift: Intelligent Academic Literature Search & Citation Synthesis
summary: Semantic paper exploration tool combining dense vector embeddings, citation graph traversals, and automated comparative literature synthesis.
problem: Researchers spend excessive time manually combing through hundreds of PDF preprints to identify conflicting methodologies, benchmark results, and seminal citations.
solution: Developed ArticleSift, an intelligent assistant that ingests academic PDFs, parses math formulas and tables, indexes chunks in dense vector space, and generates comparative synthesis matrices with direct paragraph citations.
architecture: PDF Ingestion & Layout Analysis -> Text & Table Chunking -> Embedding Model -> Vector Store Index -> Query Engine with Hybrid RRF Re-ranking -> Markdown Citation Matrix Generator.
results: Accelerated literature survey phases by 400% for participating student researchers. Indexed 50,000+ open-access preprints with sub-800ms semantic search response time.
challenges: Handling two-column academic layouts and complex mathematical formulas without chunk corruption. Built custom heuristic PDF extraction filters.

title: Multi-Agent Autonomous Research & Systematic Synthesis Pipeline
summary: Hierarchical agentic network where specialist agents collaborate to conduct literature surveys, critique methodology claims, and generate verified synthesis reports.
problem: Single-prompt LLM workflows suffer from severe hallucinations, shallow critical critique, and unverified bibliography citations when assigned extensive research synthesis tasks.
solution: Architected a multi-agent state machine utilizing LangGraph. A Supervisor agent orchestrates three specialist personas: the Literature Surveyor (breadth retrieval), the Devil's Advocate (critique & edge-case stress testing), and the Synthesizer (balanced report authoring).
architecture: User Research Query -> Supervisor Agent -> Parallel Tasks (Surveyor Agent & Retrieval Tools) -> Devil's Advocate Peer Review Loop -> Fact-Checking Verification Tool -> Synthesizer Master Report -> Output Markdown.
results: Achieved a 94.2% verified citation rate by cross-checking DOI identifiers via live scholarly APIs. Cut hallucinated assertions by 89% compared to standalone model prompting.
challenges: Preventing circular deadlock debates between the Synthesizer and the Devil's Advocate. Designed an explicit finite-state iteration ceiling and confidence score convergence gate.
